ILSTUDIOIntersection Layout Studio

Designed by Johan Irvenå — with the machines handling the minor details.

Intersection Layout Studio is a local-first browser tool for designing and visualizing parametric road intersections. Build signal, give-way, stop, roundabout and Mixed-control layouts, including turn pockets, free-right turns, editable approach curves and roundabout mouths. Enter or import turning-movement flows, compare layout and flow scenarios, inspect standard or roundabout flow diagrams, overlay externally supplied or manually entered results, place the design over a map backdrop, and export graphics to SVG or PNG. Intersection Layout Studio visualizes and compares capacity-analysis results; it does not calculate capacity or assign formal HCM levels of service.

Built with
  • Leaflet 1.9.4 — aerial map backdrop, embedded in this file (BSD-2-Clause, © Volodymyr Agafonkin, CloudMade)
  • Nominatim — address search for the map (OpenStreetMap)
  • Basemaps (presentation only, loaded only when the map is enabled): Esri Satellite, Esri Topographic and None. Provider attribution is shown in the map layer and each provider's terms apply.
Keyboard shortcuts
⌘/Ctrl+ZUndo ⌘/Ctrl+⇧Z / YRedo EscClose dialog / menu Space / EnterFlip focused toggle ←↑→↓Move design over photo (Calibrate) ⇧+arrows… in 5 m steps

Mouse: scroll zooms on the cursor, drag pans, double-click resets the view. Shortcuts are suppressed while typing in a text field.

Conventions

Right-hand traffic conventions throughout (Sweden / EU). Geometry is parametric in metres. Junction control styles are traffic signal, give-way, stop, roundabout and Mixed controls; Mixed controls allow give-way, stop, traffic signal or no regulation per approach. Flows are stored by approach and turning movement by vehicle type. Roundabouts can also display derived circulating flows. Capacity-analysis results are externally supplied or manually entered and can include degree of saturation, delay and queue information for display and comparison.

Theme

Start from a preset, then adjust any part. Changes apply instantly and persist across sessions.
